propositions: Phantom SYNC-dependent checks (orphaned, duplicates, stale) are permanently empty and must be removed from fsck structured output and human report.
Unknown event types must be detected using a two-stage git-based ref scan without requiring a tickets checkout, with proper handling of JSON spacing variants and false-positive exclusion.

Binding index integrity must be verified offline by checking forward/reverse consistency: confirmed forward entries require a Jira key and matching reverse entry; reverse entries must point to confirmed forward entries with matching Jira keys.
Git operational failures (missing executable, missing ref, malformed output, exit >=2, candidate-read failure) must raise RebarError with returncode=2 and exit the CLI with status 2.
Store integrity findings gate fsck with exit 1, while unknown_event_types remains informational and binding_drift remains non-gating per existing semantics.
BRIDGE_ALERT event emission, reduction to TicketState.bridge_alerts, bridge_state/bridge_alerts JSONL channel, and bridge-status compatibility command must be preserved unchanged.
